prompts.lion: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a transparent original drawing animation sheet for a toddler wildlife game. Input image is the current low-poly friendly male lion, exact character and rendering style reference. Create ONE 3 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet of 6 full-body original drawings, ordered left to right then top to bottom. Same friendly low-poly golden male lion lying down, looking to the right, paws planted at precisely the same location in every cell. Frame 1 relaxed closed mouth same reference; 2 raises his muzzle slightly, lips start parting; 3 mouth medium open; 4 a gentle proud roar with clearly open mouth, no aggression, no exaggerated fangs; 5 mouth medium open relaxing; 6 mouth closed settling into exact frame 1 pose. Maintain identical torso, mane, proportions, camera, facing and light across frames. Only neck/head/jaw show gentle anatomical change, tail can lift a little. Complete lion and all paws/tail fully visible in each cell with generous separation, no cell touching. Identical cell size and baseline. Stylized faceted 3D children's illustration, NOT realistic fur. Transparent background true alpha, no labels, no text, no boxes, no scenery, no checkerboard.
prompts.polarbear: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent original drawing animation sheet for a toddler wildlife game. Input image is the current low-poly friendly polar bear, exact character style reference. Create ONE sheet 3 columns by 2 rows containing 6 full-body ORIGINAL drawings ordered left to right then top to bottom. The polar bear looks left in side to mild three-quarter view. Frame 1 resting on four planted paws; 2 sitting back gently onto haunches with forepaws still near ground; 3 lifting torso with hind paws firmly planted; 4 standing upright on both hind paws, front paws relaxed at chest, friendly curious expression; 5 lowering torso into seated position; 6 settled on four paws exactly like frame 1. All 4 limbs must be anatomically accounted for in every drawing. These are a single stand-up and settle gesture, NOT walking. Preserve same cream-white faceted low-poly character, black nose/eyes, no realistic fur, no clothing, no human proportions. Same body size and baseline position in identical cells; fully visible head, hind paws, arms with generous transparent margin. Do not crop upright bear. True transparent alpha background, no text, labels, boxes, checkerboard or scenery.
